integrity: The exact value is supported by a human-readable polyhedral reduction and a standalone exact-arithmetic verifier over \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)\); no numerical sampling is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is confined to the displayed real regular-octagonal norm. Literature comparison can miss unindexed or differently phrased prior computations.
title: Exact \(T_G\) constant of the regular octagonal Banach plane
